title: The rare return branch
hook: Most toy ventures lose one credit. How much can a rare large return change the average?

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Locate the rare branch whose weighted magnitude changes the expected net despite unchanged failure frequency.

misconception: If most ventures fail, the rare successful outcomes cannot determine the portfolio average.
objective: Locate the rare branch whose weighted magnitude changes the expected net despite unchanged failure frequency.
